description: 跨 fact_sales + fact_returns 的多事实表对比

turns.query: 2024年各产品类别的销售额和退货金额对比

golden.sql: WITH sales AS (  SELECT p.category AS category, SUM(o.order_amount) AS amount   FROM fact_orders o JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = o.product_id   JOIN dim_date d ON d.full_date = o.order_date   WHERE d.year = 2024 GROUP BY p.category), refunds AS (  SELECT p.category AS category, SUM(pay.payment_amount) AS amount   FROM fact_payments pay JOIN fact_orders o ON o.order_id = pay.order_id   JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = o.product_id   JOIN dim_date d ON d.full_date = o.order_date   WHERE d.year = 2024 AND pay.status = 'REFUNDED' GROUP BY p.category) SELECT s.category AS category, ROUND(s.amount, 2) AS sales, ROUND(COALESCE(r.amount, 0), 2) AS refund FROM sales s LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.category = s.category ORDER BY sales DESC
